Write a C program to print your name, date of birth, and mobile number.
Expected Output:

Name   : Alexandra Abramov  
DOB    : July 14, 1975  
Mobile : 99-9999999999

knowledge_point: Data Type Conversion; User Input; Arithmetic Operations; Output / String Formatting

Pythagoras Solver
Using the existing right-angled triangle program as an example, write a program which takes two floating-point numbers from the user which represent the lengths of the two shortest sides of a right-angled triangle. The program should then calculate and print the length of the longest side.
